title: Archived reports lack bounded authenticated reuse
symptom: Warm report reuse, invalidation, anti-spoof and timeout regressions fail because no authenticated live response is recorded.
trigger: Run the native cache regressions at the failing-first commit before the cache implementation.
expected: A completed authenticated archive read primes bounded read-only reuse; invalid or timed-out inputs stay live and write no authenticated entry.
actual: Four regressions fail with live response count 0 instead of 1; the two independent controls pass.
steps: At commit 1f94916d9a1c7b0c017b528838b9137e973cfa85, run the native test target before implementing the cache.
impact: Archived next and status retain their native-status latency; lifecycle authority is unchanged.

notes.text: status: open -> verified. The implemented cache passes the warm-reuse, invalidation and timeout cases after the preserved failing-first receipt.
